# Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus

Screen orientation lock, unlock, change events, and per-page set for .NET MAUI. More than DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-device-orientation-plus
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus

Registration: `UseDeviceOrientationPlus` (optional) — see README.md.

```csharp
Orientation.Lock(ScreenOrientation.Portrait);
Orientation.Unlock();
Orientation.Changed += (_, e) => { /* e.Current */ };
await Orientation.SetAsync(ScreenOrientation.Landscape);
```

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I lock orientation in .NET MAUI?
- How do I force landscape / portrait on a page?
- DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation is read-only
- Orientation changed event in MAUI
- Video, document scanning, POS, dashboard, camera, vehicle inspection orientation

## Do not use when

- You only need to read `DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation`
- Windows or Mac Catalyst is a first-class target
